newDefectFound.title: A SECOND, INDEPENDENT COPY OF THE BARE-NEGATION DEFECT, in the display evidence boundary, which zeroes the risk band and strips every standard whenever the word 'nobody' or 'no one' appears anywhere in the observation.
newDefectFound.howItWasFound: Only by running the HZ-9 proof against the real production runtime. Every §299 local proof passes unchanged, because §299 exercised buildEvidenceFacts and applyEvidenceFoundation and this module sits downstream of both. The artifact-identity argument §299 relied on could not have found it either. THIS IS THE ARGUMENT FOR HZ-9 HAVING EXISTED AT ALL.
newDefectFound.mechanism: `affirmativelyNoExposure` is a regular expression whose alternation includes the BARE words `nobody` and `no one`, anchored to nothing about exposure — the identical shape §299 repaired in shared-evidence-facts.ts. It alone sets `affirmativelyControlled`, which sets assessmentDisposition='controlled_condition', sets mustDemote=true (emptying primaryCitation, primaryStandards, suggestedStandards and standards) and OVERWRITES result.risk with riskScore 0, riskBand 'Controlled', imminentDanger false, requiresShutdown false. It also emits a LOW-priority 'Verify the controlled condition' action.

measuredInProduction.observation: a worker three feet from an unguarded twelve-foot-wide opening with a ten-foot drop, no harness, no anchor points

newDefectFound.causationIsolatedLocally: The SAME note with ONLY the two bare quantifiers reworded — 'Nobody working up there' -> 'None of the stockers up there', 'Nobody was injured' -> 'There were no injuries' — and every hazard fact identical, yields: assessmentDisposition hazard_requires_human_review, riskBand Critical, riskScore 20, imminentDanger TRUE, requiresShutdown TRUE, primaryCitation 29 CFR 1910.28, primaryStandards 1. THE WORD ALONE FLIPS IT.
newDefectFound.severityProposed: P0 FOR EXTERNAL BETA, on the same reasoning the product owner used to escalate HZ-4, and arguably stronger: HZ-4 suppressed the regulatory basis while the hazard stayed Critical; this zeroes the hazard itself and tells the reader the condition is CONTROLLED and requires no shutdown.
newDefectFound.notRepairedHere: §300 scopes Phase 1 to HZ-9 and Phase 2 to HZ-6/HZ-7. HZ-10 is neither. It is registered with a reproduction and a remediation and is NOT repaired in this section.
newDefectFound.secondAlternationInTheSameFunction: The `affirmativelyControlled` second clause carries another bare-word list — nobody | no one | passed | within | fully | complete | closed | secured — gated behind controlsPresent>0 and controlsMissing===0. It did not fire here because no structuredObservation was supplied, but it is the same class of error and must be examined in the same repair.
